intro.text: An Elantrian, once a worker on Aor Plantation, whom the Derethi bring out of Elantris to be questioned.

items.text: About eight months after the Shaod took him, Diren was brought to Hrathen so that the gyorn could learn about Elantris. Dilaf then took him and slashed his face deeply again and again until his mind gave way.
When Dilaf moved to execute Diren before the congregation, Hrathen stopped him to keep the crowd from working itself into a frenzy, then ended Diren's suffering himself.
